content: BR solo lash designer booking apps (DottoVip, Bellagenda, Agende-me, agendamento.link, TopAgenda): common pattern is client self-books 24h via link, pays Pix deposit at booking, gets automatic WhatsApp reminder and confirmation, no manual approval. Agende-me prices a solo Profissional plan around R59.90 per month vs Empresa plan around R99.90 per month for up to 6 pros, confirming solo tier is a distinct cheaper product tier in this market.
